title: Writhe-Based Polymer Link Classification Using Machine Learning
summary: Unique and rapid classification of knots and links is an open mathematical problem that is relevant to a range of (bio)physical systems, including polymer melts, DNA, and proteins. In this paper, we explore a data-driven approach to the classification problem of link topology. Extending the framework introduced in Ref. 1 (Sleiman et al, 2024 Soft Matter, 20(1), pp.71-78), we show that a feedforward neural network trained on the writhe density matrix classifies thermally equilibrated configurations of the first six prime links with 97% accuracy.
